title: Lead Me in Your Righteousness

questions.question: Give ear to my words, O Lord; consider my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:1 (ESV): "Give ear to my words, O Lord; consider my groaning."

questions.question: In the morning you hear my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:3 (ESV): "O Lord, in the morning you hear my voice;"

questions.question: For you are not a God who delights in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:4 (ESV): "For you are not a God who delights in wickedness; evil may not dwell with you."

questions.question: You destroy those who speak what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:6 (ESV): "You destroy those who speak lies;"

questions.question: Lead me, O Lord, in your righteousness because of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:8 (ESV): "Lead me, O Lord, in your righteousness because of my enemies;"

questions.question: In the morning I prepare a sacrifice for you and do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:3 (ESV): "...in the morning I prepare a sacrifice for you and watch."

questions.question: The Lord abhors the bloodthirsty and what kind of man?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:6 (ESV): "...the Lord abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man."

questions.question: But I, through the abundance of your steadfast love, will enter your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:7 (ESV): "But I, through the abundance of your steadfast love, will enter your house."

questions.question: Make your way straight before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:8 (ESV): "...make your way straight before me."

questions.question: For there is no truth in their mouth; their throat is an open what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:9 (ESV): "...their throat is an open grave; they flatter with their tongue."

questions.question: Let them fall by their own what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:10 (ESV): "Make them bear their guilt, O God; let them fall by their own counsels;"

questions.question: But let all who take refuge in you do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:11 (ESV): "But let all who take refuge in you rejoice; let them ever sing for joy,"

questions.question: For you bless the righteous, O Lord; you cover him with favor as with a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:12 (ESV): "For you bless the righteous, O Lord; you cover him with favor as with a shield."

questions.question: The boastful shall not stand before your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:5 (ESV): "The boastful shall not stand before your eyes; you hate all evildoers."

questions.question: I will bow down toward your holy temple in the fear of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 5:7 (ESV): "I will bow down toward your holy temple in the fear of you."

key_verse_text: O Lord, in the morning you hear my voice; in the morning I prepare a sacrifice for you and watch.
